# Katrina Saroyan Music

> > Professional harpist and music educator based in Los Angeles, specializing in weddings, events, and multilingual performances across Southern California.

Katrina Saroyan offers live harp music for weddings and special events throughout the Greater Los Angeles area, including Pasadena, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica, Malibu, and Orange County. She also provides music lessons in harp, violin, and piano.
